verified: electrive reports that AYK Energy will supply 165 MWh of battery systems in total, split into 55 MWh per vessel, for three all-electric catamaran ferries operated by Molslinjen and built by Incat Tasmania.
unconfirmed: delivery timing, contract value, battery chemistry and cell suppliers, charging power and shore-side infrastructure, and the routes or in-service dates for the vessels; these rest on the trade report alone, with no independent confirmation or technical datasheet.

verified: 据 electrive 报道，AYK Energy 将为 Molslinjen 的三艘全电动高速渡轮供应总容量 165 MWh 的电池系统，单船 55 MWh，船体由 Incat Tasmania 建造，为双体船型。
unconfirmed: 报道未提及电池交付与船舶投运的时间表、电池化学体系与充放电功率参数、合同金额，也未说明港口侧的大功率充电设施是否已落实；上述信息仅来自这一篇报道，暂无 AYK Energy 或 Molslinjen 的原始公告可供交叉核对。

titles.en: AYK Energy to supply 165 MWh of batteries for three Molslinjen electric ferries
titles.zh: AYK Energy 获 165 MWh 船用电池订单，配套 Molslinjen 三艘电动渡轮
